entries.human_input: None beyond P01; density is computed from the same information bank. A therapist must, however, judge whether a system with higher density really reads better.
entries.risk: Comparable only among notes of the same source material. The aligned-length control condition means a second generation run, i.e. real extra cost. The differences between the two Keren studies do not isolate length; controlled length is a proposed experiment, not a documented mechanism. The numerator, the handling of duplicates and the Czech length unit must be fixed before use; word-normalised ratios are not comparable between the languages, and density is reported with coverage, harmful omissions and comprehensibility (audit A08).
entries.saturation_detail: Nobody has ever reported density. Indirect evidence: S19 aligned length between sources and humans won on preservation of salient meaning too (d = 0.70) against the authors' own hypothesis; S18 did not align length and there the models came out as more comprehensive. The difference between the studies is exactly length.

applied_criteria.detail: Preference went to a measurement resting on a source whose full text the assistant read. Ten of the entries rest on S1, S2, S6, S7, S18 or S19.

applied_criteria.criterion: Repairs a known defect of our instrument
applied_criteria.detail: P01, P02, P06 and P07 exist because a concrete discrepancy was found between what our code does and what the source it was derived from says.

applied_criteria.criterion: Every purpose the round serves has at least one measurement
applied_criteria.detail: continuity P01/P10. Documentation was served by P09, the decree check, until the investigator dropped it on 2026-10-05; it is now served by P01, whose information bank tags each unit with the purposes it serves and reports coverage per purpose, and by the three rubric items, which apply to both purposes. Decision D8 of 2026-09-16 narrowed the round to those two purposes; supervision and client are out of scope, so P11 is read as a professional's willingness to use the system and not as a supervision or client measure.
The development budget of the protocol: a balanced human note sample, 150 human decisions, 8 to 12 hours of human work. P10 and P11 alone consume most of the human time.

applied_criteria.criterion: At least one measurement checks the instrument, not the models
applied_criteria.detail: P12. Without it we will not learn whether the numbers from the rest of the pilot mean anything at all.

applied_criteria.criterion: A rare but serious phenomenon deliberately kept
applied_criteria.detail: P03. The protocol explicitly forbids dropping an item for rarity.

deliberately_not_used.why: The protocol forbids dropping a measurement because the models do not differ on it. A small difference can mean that all are equally bad.

Out of scope by decision D8, and the worst supported of the four purposes: no source found says what a supervisor needs from a note.

Half of the construct (is the relation supported?) is already in P04. The other half (is it appropriate to the purpose?) requires a purpose-specific standard we do not have; PDSQI rewards integration, which would be wrong for a client summary. Measuring it now would mean inventing a yardstick.

Measurable only against a specific reader and the pilot has no client readers. Automatic readability indices are a stand-in, not evidence of understanding. Closely related to K24, dropped for the same reason.

left_out.reason: Adopted on 2026-09-21; no rating rule exists yet, so it is not in this round.

left_out.reason: Added on 2026-09-21; the rule for a contradicting pair is not written, so it is not in this round.

method.named: instrument development, phase one: item generation followed by content validity
method.why_not_framework_synthesis: An earlier draft called this a best-fit framework synthesis (Carroll et al., 2013). That method starts from a published framework and codes the evidence against it; ours started from this project's own prototype, so the citation did not cover what was done and is withdrawn. The reference stays in the review ledger as a report that was named and never read.

item_generation.quote: There are two ways to identify appropriate questions: deductive and inductive methods
item_generation.deductive_here: the bounded scoping search of 2026-09-13 and the instruments it found
item_generation.inductive_here: the prototype recorded before the search, three named expert proposals, and one repeated observation of this project's own outputs
item_generation.means: An item pool drawn from both is the prescribed procedure, not a mixture to apologise for. What the procedure requires instead is that the origin of every item is declared and that the pool then passes content validity.

method.measurement_rule: A candidate may be proposed for measurement only when at least one of its evidence lines quotes a source read in full. An idea may come from anywhere; what is measured must be supported. The validator enforces this.

content_validity.quote: These expert judges should be independent of those who developed the item pool
content_validity.where_we_stand: Not met. The item pool was developed by the investigator with the assistant, and the only judgement on it is the investigator's own, with the sources, evidence lines and operational rules accepted by delegation (D9, D10). The two Czech psychologists of the pilot are raters, not independent judges of content validity, and the pilot does not substitute for that judgement.

method.reporting: COSMIN's content-validity criteria (S11) name relevance, comprehensiveness and comprehensibility as what such a judgement has to cover; this round reports which of them nobody has assessed.

derivation.reported_from: the source-first extraction (source-properties.json): every property of note quality each source read in full defines, in the source's own words
derivation.convergence: 35 of the 36 candidates are anchored in at least one such property. The exception is K06, acknowledged information gap, which no source defines as a property of a note and which stands on the observation this project declares as its origin. Two of the 35, K35 and K36, were anchored on 2026-10-07 when SESPI was read in full; until then its abstract row was mapped to two candidates that are not what it measures.
derivation.prior_map_role: the 26-criterion map recorded on 2026-09-12, before the search, is reported as the comparison the framework was tested against, not as its derivation: 8 criteria kept, 12 revised on what the sources say, 6 merged and 11 added.
derivation.caveat: The extraction was written by the assistant that had already written the catalog, source by source and without the catalog open, with the mapping done afterwards. It is not a blind replication and is not reported as one.

decision_basis.source: the transcript decides; a deviation is a defect and the direction of quality is not a convention
decision_basis.norm: a written specification decides: a template, a regulation, the task's instruction
decision_basis.note: determinate from the note alone, without the transcript; any trained reader reaches the same answer
decision_basis.rater: a professional's verdict, with nothing external behind it; the only evidence of its validity is agreement between raters
decision_basis.derived: computed from other measures rather than from a reference of its own; the direction is clear but the number is not independent
decision_basis.indicator: describes rather than grades: it has no target value, and reading it as more-is-better would invent a direction the data does not carry
